title: Remote clients
text: Run yoke connect with the team server origin. Without company sign-in, choose your own machine for approval by an already connected machine, Enter invite code for a teammate's first machine, or Back without changing connections. An admin creates the code with yoke invite and sends it privately. Non-interactive and --json runs never show the choice and default to own-machine approval; --invite-code-stdin reads a private code. Company sign-in goes directly to personal browser approval. With --token-file or --token-stdin, connect registers the machine against the destination and stores its machine-bound credential before relay setup. A local universe is reachable here only; use yoke self-host init to make a reachable team server. Connect installs or reuses the destination’s machine relay using its saved environment and config. --no-activate leaves the active connection unchanged. Each sign-in replaces this machine's credential on that server, so connect checks the other saved connections to the same server URL and moves only those the server reports revoked to the new credential; working tokens stay, and any it could not check are reported. A registration or relay setup failure returns connection_saved and a destination-scoped retry. Check authenticated heartbeat readiness with relay status on the destination.
